tools.name: open_keyboard_tester
tools.description: Opens a keyboard tester for a board layout such as ANSI US or ISO UK. Each key lights up when the keyboard registers it, and the tester counts the keys received. Returns the board's keys and labels.

tools.name: start_typing_test
tools.description: Starts a timed typing test of 30, 60 or 120 seconds and returns its words from the website's English word list. The test reports words per minute, accuracy and errors when time is up.

tools.name: get_keycode
tools.description: Returns the values a key reports in a browser key event: key, code, keyCode, which and location. Accepts a key name such as Enter or Shift, or one character on a US keyboard, and lists the left, right and number-pad variants.

tools.name: check_rollover
tools.description: Opens a rollover test that shows the keys held down at once and the largest number of keys the keyboard registered together. Returns a full-size ANSI board with no inputs needed.

tools.name: get_layout
tools.description: Returns the key map of a keyboard layout with plain, Shift and AltGr characters, and the website's notes on it. Layouts include QWERTY, AZERTY, QWERTZ, Dvorak, Colemak, Workman and regional layouts.

tools.name: compare_layouts
tools.description: Compares two keyboard layouts and returns the keys that type different characters. Adds the website's example-text counts of home-row use and same-finger letter pairs for each. QWERTY and Dvorak without names.

tools.name: find_switches
tools.description: Finds keyboard switches in the website's catalog by feel, actuation force and sound recordings, and returns their specifications. A force matches switches that list a value within 10 gf of it, and a set that offers several feels is listed under each of them.

tools.name: plan_keyboard_build
tools.description: Plans a keyboard build from the website's reviewed combinations of barebones kit, switches and keycaps. Returns the parts, fit checks, switch quantities and the parts list as the builder writes it.
